name: codex-capability-profiler
description: Generate a private, evidence-labeled dashboard of how Codex capabilities appear across local task history.

interface.shortDescription: Audit how deeply Codex capabilities are used.
interface.longDescription: Scans local Codex task history, reconciles source coverage, classifies workflow signals, and generates private HTML, Markdown, and JSON maturity reports with an optional redacted sharing mode.
defaultPrompt: Profile my local Codex capability maturity.
Audit whether every local Codex task is included.
